source.description:
Portrait of Sangpuy

Sangpuy, the celebrated indigenous singer known for his award-winning performances, is photographed in a studio setting wearing a matching denim jacket and wide-leg jeans. His white platform shoes and distinctive mullet haircut add a modern edge to the minimalist composition.

The neutral backdrop and soft lighting draw attention to Sangpuy’s calm expression and fashion-forward ensemble. This portrait highlights both his cultural identity and contemporary style.

source.description:
Portrait of Sangpuy

Sangpuy, hailing from the Pinyumayan tribe of Katratripulr on Taiwan’s Pacific southeast coast, learned his ancestral music, language, and traditions where mountain meets ocean. His voice, often described as carrying a “pure, primitive sense,” has earned him multiple Golden Melody Awards for Best Indigenous Singer and Best Album of the Year.

Sangpuy’s Stage Presence

Sangpuy, the acclaimed Puyuma singer and two-time Golden Melody Award winner, delivers a powerful performance under a spotlight. Adorned with a traditional leafy crown and dressed in a dark, embroidered outfit, he stands before a microphone, embodying the fusion of indigenous heritage and contemporary music.

Drawing inspiration from his Taitung homeland and agricultural life, Sangpuy’s music in the Puyuma language resonates with themes of nature, community, and resilience. source.description:
Sangpuy’s Cultural Performance

Sangpuy, the acclaimed Puyuma singer-songwriter from Taitung, Taiwan, celebrates his third Golden Melody Award for Best Indigenous Language Singer. His album “得力量 pulu’em” garnered eight nominations at the 32nd Golden Melody Awards, and he accepted the award with heartfelt thanks to his ancestors, community, and production team. In his speech, he urged support for indigenous land rights and environmental justice across Taiwan.
